description: Fetch the content tree for a course showing modules, topics, files, and links. Use this when the user asks about course materials, lecture slides, uploaded files, content structure, or what's in a course module. Use moduleTitle to filter to a specific module at any depth (e.g. 'Labs', 'Staff', 'HW12') instead of fetching the entire tree. Do not use modifiedSince to decide whether a file exists: it filters on when the instructor last edited an item, so early-uploaded files are missed (see its description). Use maxDepth to limit recursion depth for a table-of-contents view. A module or topic that isn't currently available carries isAvailable/availabilityStatus/availabilityMessage (and startDate/endDate when known) explaining why; absence of these fields means it's available now. To find what is new or missing from the student's saved files ("pull from Brightspace", "what don't I have yet"), call get_unsaved_course_files: it compares the course's content topics by topic id with what download_file and download_course_files saved, then download each listed topic with download_file (topicId). Never conclude a file is absent or not new from get_course_content's modifiedSince: an instructor can upload a file weeks before releasing it, and releasing it does not change its lastModified.

courseId.description: Course ID to get content tree for.

maxDepth.description: Limit recursive depth of the content tree, counted from the course root even when moduleTitle is set. Depth 1 returns top-level modules with direct children only. Useful for getting a table of contents without all nested content.

modifiedSince.description: Only return topics last modified at or after this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. 2026-01-15T00:00:00Z), plus any module that contains a matching topic. Topics with no modified timestamp are always included. When set, the response reports how many topics were filtered out, and each kept module lists the topics it lost in hiddenByFilter. lastModified is when the instructor last edited the item, not when it became visible to the student, so files uploaded early and released later are missed. Never use this filter to conclude a file is absent: to check one assignment's files, call without modifiedSince or use search_course.

moduleTitle.description: Case-insensitive substring match on module titles at any depth, including modules nested inside other modules (e.g. 'Labs', 'Staff', 'HW12'). Each matching module is returned with its full subtree and a path such as 'Homeworks > HW12'; a module inside a match is not listed again. If no title matches, the response says so: that does not mean the module is empty, try search_course.

typeFilter.description: Optional filter to narrow results by content type.

name: get_course_content
title: Get Course Content
